div.div: One account per environment — each holds its own sign-in, authorization, data, Lambda, images, CI roles and Terraform state; nothing in one account trusts another, and no stack reads another account's state. Stacks: prod infra/prod/account + infra/prod/app, dev and stage infra/<env>/{account,app}. Vercel env vars are scoped by target and git_branch, one set per account. Local npm run dev signs in against dev's pool. Not drawn: ACM certificates for the auth domains, Vercel DNS records, the Lambda exec role (its own bucket only).
